display_name: Africanus, companion of Publius and Terentius

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Μαρτίου, «Άγιοι Αφρικανός, Πούπλιος και Τερέντιος οι Μάρτυρες», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 13 марта ст. ст., «Мученик Африкан Петрийский (Африканский)», with the rank word left off. The day's own line declines the name to «Африкана» and gives no epithet.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 марта ст. ст. — «Мчч. Африкана, Публия и Терентия (III).»

attestations.note: The line is one line for the three and this folder is one of them; the Russian day agrees with the Greek 13 Μαρτίου this folder already carried. The short reading the line links, life633, sets their suffering at Петрия in the third century and gives no governor, no emperor and no year. The calendar's name page for him, 313, also serves a second and much longer reading, life822, of a Terence with a company of forty in Africa under Decius; the two are not the same company and nothing in this folder is taken from the second.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Αφρικανός, Πούπλιος και Τερέντιος οι Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The page enumerates the three, has them arrested as Christians and brought before the governor of their country, sealed three days in a furnace and found unhurt, thrown on burning coals and at last beheaded; it says their synaxis was kept «στη μονή Παυλοπετρείου, κοντά στο Παντείχιον της Μ. Ασίας», that Theodore the Reader puts the translation of their relics under Theodosius I «(379-395 μ.Χ.), στις 21 Σεπτεμβρίου» into St Euphemia of Petra, and that «σύμφωνα με τον Λαυριωτικό κώδικα, μαζί με τους ανωτέρω Αγίους αριθμείται και ο Σαβίνος και οι συν αυτώ». It gives no year for the martyrdom and no hymn. The corpus's Africanus and Terentius of Africa are the Romanian 10 April, another company with other companions; these are the three of the Greek 13 March.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line for 13 марта ст. ст. with «(III)», and the reading behind it says «Святые мученики Африкан, Публий и Терентий пострадали в III веке в Петрии». The century is all either gives.
